name: Ayami Yuuki
source: Fresh to the system, Ayami takes her studies lightly, tending to focus more on the ins-and-outs of those she comes across. As upbeat as she may seem, her sensitive side isn't one to be toyed with either. With the facades of life ever overwhelming, Ayami finds comfort in the honesty of those around her.
